1	# Plan 2026-05-15: Root Facade Extraction Inventory for `fizeau-cd9af16b`
2	
3	This inventory is the design prerequisite for parent bead `fizeau-cd9af16b`.
4	It reconciles that parent with ADR-008 instead of trying to land the
5	non-executable requirement "zero root `.go` files."
6	
7	## Governing constraint
8	
9	ADR-008 keeps the module root as the public facade:
10	
11	- `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-008-service-package-and-transcript-boundaries.md`
12	  says `github.com/easel/fizeau` remains the compatibility boundary and that
13	  concrete execution, transcript, route-health, quota, and routing-quality
14	  mechanics move behind `internal/*`.
15	- `service.go` defines the public `FizeauService` interface and the root
16	  request/response/event types that downstream code already imports.
17	- `website/content/docs/embedding/_index.md` documents the root package as the
18	  importable library surface and lists the public packages under this module.
19	
20	Because ADR-008 explicitly rejects both a nested `fizeau/` package and a
21	module split as the immediate answer, parent AC #1 ("zero root `.go` files")
22	is incompatible with the accepted design unless a separate change first ships a
23	replacement public package, updates generated docs, and migrates consumers.
24	
25	The executable interpretation of `fizeau-cd9af16b` is therefore:
26	
27	1. Keep the root `package fizeau` importable at `github.com/easel/fizeau`.
28	2. Split mixed root files into public contract stubs plus internal
29	   implementation owners.
30	3. Move implementation-owned files and white-box tests behind the
31	   ADR-008-aligned `internal/*` packages.
32	4. Leave only the public facade, intentional shims, and root black-box
33	   contract tests at the module root.
34	
35	## In-repo consumers of `github.com/easel/fizeau`
36	
37	These consumers make the root facade a real compatibility boundary today.
38	
39	| Consumer | Evidence | Why root removal breaks it |
40	|---|---|---|
41	| `agentcli/` | `agentcli/harnesses_command.go`, `agentcli/policies_command.go`, `agentcli/route_status.go`, `agentcli/routing_smart.go`, `agentcli/run.go`, plus related tests | Directly imports root service types such as `FizeauService`, `UsageReportOptions`, `OverrideClassBucket`, harness status, and routing/report surfaces. |
42	| `cmd/bench/` | `cmd/bench/configadapter.go`, `cmd/bench/discovery.go`, `cmd/bench/external_termbench.go`, `cmd/bench/runner.go` | Directly imports root config-adapter, service, and routing/model surfaces. |
43	| `cmd/fiz/` | `cmd/fiz/main.go` imports `github.com/easel/fizeau/agentcli` | Transitive consumer: `cmd/fiz` builds through `agentcli`, and `agentcli` is a direct root-package consumer guarded by import-boundary tests. |
44	| Root black-box tests | `routing_errors_example_test.go`, `service_events_test.go`, `service_execute_test.go`, `service_final_usage_zero_test.go`, `service_harness_dispatch_test.go`, `service_new_test.go`, `service_override_test.go`, `service_policies_test.go`, `service_progress_test.go`, `service_public_api_smoke_test.go`, `service_role_correlation_test.go`, `service_taillog_test.go`, `service_test.go`, `testseam_test.go` | These tests exist specifically to prove the root import path remains a usable external facade. |
45	| `internal/config/` | `internal/config/serviceconfig.go` | Adapts loaded config into the root `ServiceConfig` interface. |
46	| `internal/benchmark/external/termbench/` | `internal/benchmark/external/termbench/plan.go` | Directly uses root request/tool-facing types. |
47	| Doc generators | `cmd/docgen-embedding/main.go`, `cmd/docgen-tools/main.go` | Directly import the root package to generate and inspect the documented public API. |
48	
49	Documentation also consumes the root facade even when it is not a Go import:
50	`website/content/docs/embedding/_index.md` and
51	`cmd/docgen-embedding/page.tmpl` both describe `github.com/easel/fizeau` as
52	the library entry point.
53	
54	## Root file inventory
55	
56	The inventory buckets every current root-level `.go` file into one of three
57	classes:
58	
59	- `Public facade`: root must keep these symbols importable, although several
60	  files are mixed and need internal logic split out.
61	- `Public compatibility alias/shim`: intentionally thin root wrappers,
62	  re-exports, or build-tag seams that exist so consumers do not import
63	  `internal/*`.
64	- `Implementation-owned`: concrete mechanics or white-box tests that should
65	  move behind the named internal-package owner.
66	
67	## Post-extraction root source allowlist
68	
69	Update 2026-05-15: the ADR-008 extraction chain is now far enough along that
70	the module root should be read as an explicit allowlist, not as the planning
71	inventory above. The enforced source-file set is locked by
72	`TestRootFacadeSourceAllowlist` in `service_root_facade_allowlist_test.go`.

241	## Ordered extraction slices
242	
243	The parent bead should be broken into these smaller execution slices, in this
244	order.
245	
246	| Order | Slice | Files/scope | Target internal owners |
247	|---|---|---|---|
248	| 1 | Thin the mixed root facade | Split `service.go`, `service_events.go`, `service_session_projection.go`, `service_override.go`, `service_routing_quality.go`, `service_catalog_cache.go`, `service_aliveness.go`, `service_probe.go`, `service_capabilities.go`, `routing_errors.go`, and `role_correlation.go` into public contract declarations plus private adapters/helpers. No consumer import changes yet. | `internal/serviceimpl`, `internal/transcript`, `internal/routehealth`, `internal/quota`, `internal/routingquality` |
249	| 2 | Move execute/runtime mechanics | Move `metadata_billing.go`, `service_execute.go`, `service_execute_dispatch.go`, `service_harness_instances.go`, `service_model_resolution.go`, `service_models.go`, `service_native_provider.go`, `service_policies.go`, `service_projection.go`, `service_providers.go`, `service_reasoning.go`, `service_refresh_scheduler.go`, `service_routing.go`, `service_snapshot.go`, `service_status.go`, and `service_stale_harness_reaper*.go`, along with their white-box tests. | `internal/serviceimpl` |
250	| 3 | Move transcript and session-log ownership | Move `service_progress.go`, `service_session_log.go`, `service_taillog.go`, and transcript/session white-box tests so progress rendering and replay stay Fizeau-owned but no longer live in the root package. | `internal/transcript`, `internal/session` |
251	| 4 | Move route-health, quota, and routing-quality state | Move `service_route_attempts.go`, `service_route_leases.go`, `service_routestatus.go`, `service_subscription_quota.go`, quota helpers/tests, and routing-quality helpers/tests. Drain the routehealth-specific helper code out of `service_routing.go` during the same sequence. | `internal/routehealth`, `internal/quota`, `internal/routingquality` |
252	| 5 | Root cleanup and contract lock | After slices 1-4 land, keep only the root facade, the intentional shims, and black-box contract tests at the module root. Regenerate the embedding docs and re-run the CLI/service boundary checks before touching downstream DDx work. | Existing owners above; no new public package |
253	
254	## Non-goals for the parent bead
255	
256	- Do not chase "zero root `.go` files" on this module.
257	- Do not remove the root public package.
258	- Do not rewrite `agentcli/`, `cmd/bench/`, or generated embedding docs to a
259	  different import path unless a separate design explicitly replaces the root
260	  facade.
